items.title: SD-018 AMEND validation: does supervising z_world on the DIRECTIONAL resource field lift a z_world-only reader's foraging competence? (+ fishtank observable)
items.note: OWED POST-IMPLEMENTATION VALIDATION of the SD-018 AMEND (directional resource-field head on z_world), landed ree-v3 028a625 2026-09-02, whose own commit message records 'Validation experiment NOT queued'. Routing chip chip-20260902-sd018-fieldhead-validation-run. EVIDENCE (not diagnostic): INV-088 primary, MECH-457 read-across only. | DESIGN: 2 arms + 2 anchors. field_loss_off / field_loss_on both BUILD the directional head and run the identical x734 all-ON stack; the ONLY difference is the P0a loss weight (zworld_p0_resource_field_weight 0.0 vs 0.5). Both arms' PPO readers see z_world ALONE (32 dims) -- the side-channel V3-EXQ-948 used is REMOVED, which is what this run contributes that 948 could not: 948 proved the field CONTENT is sufficient for competence by concatenating it onto the reader's input; it said nothing about whether that content can be carried THROUGH z_world. Env kwargs, rung (D3_hazard_free), weighting (W3_survival_zeroed), seeds, PPO hyperparameters, eval protocol and P0/P1 budgets are imported from x734/x808 rather than redefined. Both arms get their OWN warmup -- forced, because here the manipulation IS the encoder's training objective, so a shared warmup would erase it. | SEAM PREREQUISITE: the head was UNTRAINABLE from any driver in this family until 2026-09-02 (ZWorldP0Config.resource_field_weight defaults 0.0; run_zworld_p0 passed no override; _train_all_on_agent calls neither field loss). Seam LANDED ree-v3 65c37c8 (origin/main), pinned by contract C6 in tests/contracts/test_sd018_resource_field_head.py. chip-20260902-sd018-p0a-field-weight-seam. | GOV-REUSE-1 (step 2.4): no manifest under evidence/experiments/ carries resource_field_weight or used_resource_field_head -- the substrate did not exist until today, so nothing is recoverable by reanalysis. Run required. | red-team (fable): 8 findings, ALL APPLIED before queueing, none waived. F1 (confirmed by independent measurement) -- constructing resource_field_head consumes torch RNG draws and SplitEncoder builds it BEFORE world_topdown/self_topdown, so an arm pair differing in whether the head EXISTS also differs in the random init of modules that are never trained (world_path_parameters() = world_encoder + world_precision_logit only) yet feed sense()-time z_world directly: an arm-correlated untrained random term in the exact quantity the reader consumes. Fixed by building the head in BOTH arms. F8 -- p1 was passing P1_REINFORCE+P1_PPO (1090) where the family passes P1_REINFORCE (90), a 12x budget drift; fixed. F2/F5(doc) -- the manipulation is a REWEIGHTING not presence-vs-absence (reconstruction_weight 10.0 already reconstructs the full 250-wide world_obs INCLUDING the field at [225:250], so the OFF arm is supervised on it at 10/250 per element and the ON arm adds 0.5/25, a ~1.5x reweighting); the OFF arm's ABSOLUTE decode r2 is therefore as informative as the lift. F3 -- an uninformative branch was reporting dir_inv088='weakens'; the two null branches (P0a never moved z_world's field content; decode unmeasurable) are statements about THIS recipe and instrumentation, not about the hypothesis, and now report 'unknown', with a distinct label decode_unmeasurable_direction_unattributable separating an unmeasurable decode from a measured flat one. Extended to the partial-non-vacuity case: a RED ON arm emits no claim direction at all. F4 -- C_decode_lift required only the 0.05 margin, satisfiable between two sub-mean decodes (r2 -0.90 -> -0.85 is a lift of nothing); now also requires r_on > 0 absolutely. F5(code) -- new ON-arm precondition field_head_decodes_on_arm on P0a's OWN held-out field r2 > 0, so a head that RAN but LEARNED NOTHING reads as a failed operating point rather than as a scientific null about SD-018 (field_leg_ran is only a CONFIGURATION predicate). F6 -- encoder-path participation ratio and decode reported alongside the sense-time ones. F7 -- the fishtank trace logs the head's argmax on BOTH the sense-time z_world the policy consumes AND the encoder-path z_world P0a actually trains; sense-time z is (world_encoder(w) + world_topdown(...)) * prec while P0a trains world_encoder(w) * prec alone, so a head that tracks the gradient on the encoder path but not at sense time localises the failure to the top-down term -- the observation that would route a null to shape (b) rather than back to the P0a recipe. | FISHTANK: the user asked to be able to WATCH this. A separate, additional log pass (NOT the scored data -- the DV comes from evaluate_seed on its own fresh env) writes <run_id>_episode_log.json in the schema REE_assembly/fishtank_viz.html renders, carrying per step resource_field_true_argmax, resource_field_pred_argmax and resource_field_pred_argmax_encoder_path on BOTH arms, so the OFF arm is the untrained within-run chance baseline rather than a null column. | PRE-REGISTERED NULL: if ON does not clear the 1.0 D3 floor and the decode did not lift, shape (b) (routing the raw field past z_world as a side-channel) is the next build -- a real pre-registered outcome, not a failure of this run. | Smoke PASS (--dry-run 2026-09-02): both arms constructed, P0a field leg confirmed ACTUALLY RAN on the ON arm only (used_resource_field_head True w=0.5 vs False w=0.0), encoder-path PR 3.74 vs sense-time 5.07 confirming the two paths genuinely differ, F5c precondition correctly marked the ON arm red under a 2-episode budget WITHOUT vacating the OFF arm, and per-claim direction correctly read 'unknown' rather than weakening INV-088. validate_experiments.py --strict OK on all 30 checks. Contract gate: 5525 passed full six-root suite (hub) plus 819 passed on the corpus-lint + SD-018 subset. | episodes_per_run 1350 = 60 P0a + 200 P0 + 90 P1-REINFORCE + 1000 P1-PPO per TRAINING cell; the 2 anchor conditions train nothing. | FISHTANK VIEWER: REE_assembly 4c14694f13 adds the SD-018 overlay that draws the true gradient peak and both predicted peaks on the tank, with a majority-cell baseline (NOT uniform 1/25) because an untrained constant-argmax head reads 95% against uniform chance. | RE-DERIVE BRAKE (step 2.5b): FIRES on both claims (INV-088 4 counted autopsies, MECH-457 11) and is ADJUDICATED EXEMPT under the documented 'redesign of a different mechanism' clause -- stated explicitly rather than ignored. Those autopsies established a ceiling against the PRE-AMEND substrate; this run is the first test of the SD-018 directional resource-field head, which did not exist before ree-v3 028a625 (2026-09-02) and could not receive a single gradient step from any driver in this family until the P0a seam landed (65c37c8, same day). It is therefore not a same-granularity lettered re-test that re-derives a known ceiling -- the substrate under it changed. Both claims independently carry pending_retest_after_substrate: True, i.e. they are flagged as AWAITING exactly this re-test once the blocking substrate lands, and it has. Two notes on the brake text itself, recorded so a later reader does not have to re-derive them: (a) it names 'SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training' as INV-088's blocking upstream, taken from the latest counted autopsy (V3-EXQ-954, 2026-08-29) -- a DIFFERENT mechanism from the one this run tests; (b) it reports that substrate as not IMPLEMENTED, but ree-v3/CLAUDE.md line 18943 records SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training ITEM 2 as IMPLEMENTED 2026-09-01 (validated by V3-EXQ-976), so the brake appears to be matching an older ITEM's status under the same substrate name.

items.title: EXT-003/ARC-021/MECH-069 merged-channel ablation: does collapsing sensory/motor-sensory/harm channels into a shared trunk+optimizer degrade calibration_gap vs separated channels?
items.note: Dispatch brief named EXP-0522 (claim EXT-003); that proposal_id does not exist in the current, regenerated experiment_proposals.v1.json -- EXP-0528 is the (backlog_id=EVB-1248, proposal_type=experimental) row for claim_id EXT-003, confirmed by direct lookup 2026-09-02; sibling literature_review row LIT-0529 not touched here. OBJECTIVE: ARC-021's own what_would_answer field names the never-run load-bearing test: collapse E1(sensory)/E2(motor-sensory)/E3(harm-goal) into a shared trunk/single optimizer/combined loss and check whether SD-003's causal-signature calibration_gap is measurably degraded vs the separated-channel baseline (V3-EXQ-007/008/009/010, all formally FAIL against their own >0.05 bar; only EXQ-010 dense-hazards positive-direction +0.0267). A prior auto-tagged probe (2026-08-06, conf 0.5, indexed on ARC-021) is on record as explicitly NOT the decisive ablation. This is the first attempt. | GOV-REUSE-1 (step 2.4): the manipulation (merged trunk/optimizer spanning E1+E2+E3) has never been instantiated in ree_core (confirmed via substrate audit 2026-09-02: the one precedent, ARC-058's HarmForwardTrunk, spans only the two harm streams E2_harm_s/E2_harm_a, not E1/E2/E3) -- no manifest can carry this readout. Not recoverable -> run. | SUBSTRATE READINESS (2.5/2.5c): driver deliberately does NOT import ree_core.agent/REEAgent or any E1/E2/E3 predictor module -- two OPEN corrupting-severity substrate_queue entries (mode-governance-engagement, SD-082) whole-file-list ree_core/agent.py, which a module-level-match gate blocks regardless of which method is called. The manipulation (optimizer/parameter-sharing topology) is legitimately instantiated as experiment-local predictor heads (mirroring each loop's I/O role) reading off a self-contained world_encoder, exactly as V3-EXQ-010's SmallViewEnv is experiment-local env code. Footprint reduces to ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py only, which has one OPEN degrading entry (SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING, contextual_safety_harm_threshold decoupling) -- noted, not blocking; this driver never reads that field. ree_core/latent/stack.py (SplitEncoder) not imported either. | RE-DERIVE BRAKE (2.5b): the one ARC-021-tagged autopsy on record is a single preliminary/weak-power probe explicitly documented as NOT the decisive test -- count 0 toward the >=2 threshold. Brake does not fire. | RED-TEAM (fable, two passes, both recorded in the script's module docstring): pass 1 BLOCKING (F1: MERGED arm's sensory-head target created a designed-in contradiction via the STAY-token trunk pass, confirmed against dry-run data; plus F2 positive-label-only harm training, F3 MARGIN==FLOOR coupling with no seed-variance check, F4 SPARSE baseline never degeneracy-gated, F5 silent coverage-failure substitution, F6 vacuous readiness floor, F7 pooled harm-event floor masking a starved condition) -- ALL SEVEN FIXED (sensory target now self-reconstruction; harm_label always 0/1; SEPARATED_SIGNAL_FLOOR=0.02 decoupled from MARGIN=0.01; criteria are now per-condition-gated PAIRED per-seed comparisons requiring sign-consistency across all 3 seeds; per-cell coverage <5 excludes the cell; harm-event floor is MIN(dense,sparse)>=10; FORWARD_SENSITIVITY_FLOOR=0.005). Pass 2: NOT BLOCKING -- all seven fixes verified effective; three further CONTESTED/informational findings (N1 crash-guard bug FIXED; N2 docstring drift FIXED; finding-3 single-condition branch now capped at evidence_direction=mixed rather than full-strength supports/weakens, FIXED; N3 informs expectations only -- SEPARATED_SIGNAL_FLOOR sits near the top of the historical signal range, real chance of landing in degenerate/unknown for one or both conditions at full scale, an honest design tradeoff not a defect). | DV-SYMMETRY (mandatory declaration, full text in module docstring): calibration_gap is a continuous mean-difference of a sigmoid-bounded scalar, not argmax/rank-derived and not a set-aggregate over interchangeable units; the SEPARATED-vs-MERGED manipulation changes which parameters receive gradient from which loss term -- not invariant under broadcast-constant, monotone-rescaling, or permutation symmetry classes (V3-EXQ-604c precedent). | Smoke PASS (--dry-run, 2026-09-02): all 4 conditions x arms initialize/step/write cleanly; correctly self-routes to substrate_not_ready_requeue at trivial dry-run scale (0 harm events in 20 steps/cell, below the per-condition floor -- expected, not a defect). validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 non-conforming across all 30 checks. validate_recording.py --strict: OK, 0 always-core gaps. ASCII-clean. | STEP 8.6 NOT PERFORMABLE FROM THIS BOX: ree-cloud-5 has no REE_assembly/coordinator.env -- entry lands on origin/main via this commit but needs a coordinator-capable box (the Mac) to POST /queue/add before the fleet can claim it; verify by snapshot survival (~5min phase3_queue_writer tick) or hand off per skill Step 8.6.

items.title: ARC-019 precondition: LIVE closed-loop validation of the 591f crossing-count Phase 0->1 curriculum gate (crossing-count vs legacy spike, matched seeds) -- 591g re-run after aggregation crash
items.note: RE-RUN of V3-EXQ-591g (ERROR 2026-09-02T20:17:44Z, ree-cloud-2) after a crash-before-manifest. SCIENTIFIC DESIGN IS UNCHANGED FROM 591g -- see that entry for the full design/red-team/scope record, which is inherited verbatim. ROOT CAUSE of the 591g ERROR: the F4 telemetry-dropout guard added during 591g's own pre-queue red-team pass DEFINED `dropout_bypassed` seven lines BELOW the `c_discriminates` expression that CONSUMES it, so the live run died with `UnboundLocalError: local variable 'dropout_bypassed' referenced before assignment` at line 590 after all 20 cells had run (5h46m) and before any manifest was written. WHY EVERY EXISTING GATE MISSED IT: `gate_green` is the leading conjunct and is always False under --dry-run (a 3-episode dry run cannot reach PHASE_EP_MIN[1]=100, so no seed advances and precondition P1 fails), so Python short-circuits before evaluating the undefined name -- the mandatory pre-queue smoke test, `validate_experiments --strict` (all 30 checks, including dry_run_unreachable_criterion), and py_compile all pass 591g clean. FIX: statement reordering only -- the F4 guard block moves ABOVE `c_discriminates`. No DV, criterion, threshold, seed, oracle, precondition or verdict-grid change; `c_discriminates` now computes exactly what 591g's own docstring, criteria_non_degenerate and label branch already specified. VERIFICATION (positive-control, not just a green run): an aggregation probe that stubs _run_cell with the frozen 591f reference cells to force gate_green=True -- the path --dry-run can never reach -- reproduces the exact 591g crash at line 590 and completes cleanly on 591h (outcome=PASS, dropout_bypassed=[], all 5 preconditions met); an AST use-before-def scan flags 591g at 590/597 and reports 591h clean; --dry-run smoke PASS (exit 0, [train] ep 3/3, verdict: per cell, label=substrate_not_ready_requeue as expected for a short dry run); validate_experiments --strict clean. red-team: SKIP (pure crash / statement-ordering re-queue; Step 4e2 does not fire -- the manipulation -> DV -> criterion -> verdict chain is untouched). CLAIM TAGS RE-EVALUATED, not inherited: ARC-019 / non_contributory confirmed by the user at the /diagnose-errors Step 7 gate -- 591h measures the identical per-seed live Phase 0->1 advance decision under the crossing-count gate, and env_kwargs() remains informational-only so this still validates the GATE rather than the staged curriculum. COST: estimated_minutes revised 1440 -> 360 on the MEASURED 591g wall-clock (5h46m for all 20 cells on ree-cloud-2), replacing 591g's Mac-extrapolated ~23h figure.

items.title: MECH-027 hypervigilance signature: precision-scaled commit temperature + eval-boundary sleep interleave falsifier
items.note: MECH-027 hypervigilance signature falsifier (scoped single-signature probe per claim's what_would_answer + source proposal EXP-0761/EVB-1396 dispatch_mode=targeted_probe). GOV-REUSE-1 (step 2.4): 0/973+ manifests tag claim_ids containing MECH-027, 0 failure-autopsies mention MECH-027 (re-checked 2026-09-02 at queue time) -- no prior run to reuse/supersede, no re-derive brake. Adapted from a pre-existing untracked draft (authored as V3-EXQ-979) to consume two 2026-09-02 substrate builds landed on ree-v3 main (48f85f0e, de26949a; unrelated pe_surprise_threshold fix 26ae2a7e in the same range) via chip-20260902-mech027-precision-replay-eval-substrate: Build 1 (E3Config.use_precision_scaled_commit_temperature) gives the forced precision channel a graded downstream consumer instead of only the saturating binary ARC-016 commit gate; Build 2 (REEAgent.force_sleep_cycle_at_eval_boundary()) makes the forced replay-suppression channel an exercised lever by actually firing sleep cycles at eval episode boundaries in all three blocks (previously replay suppression during eval was a dead config knob nothing consulted). ID NOTE: renumbered from V3-EXQ-979 to V3-EXQ-981 at queue time -- V3-EXQ-979 was independently reserved by metaworker-chip-proposal-exp-0853-exq-979 (TASK_CLAIMS claimed_at 2026-09-02T18:41:22Z) for an unrelated MECH-157 script; this draft was never pushed before that reservation landed. P0 readiness gate extended with 7 new checks (6 for the two Build 1/2 mechanisms actually engaging -- not just configured -- plus a fatal-action-error gate) beyond the pre-existing precision/horizon/positive-control/bin-coverage checks; any unmet precondition routes to substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a claim verdict. red-team (fable): CONTESTED, 1 BLOCKING finding (F1: silent random-action substitution on _agent_tick exceptions was ungated -- fixed, new no_fatal_action_selection_errors P0 check). F3 (engagement floor was a raw count>=1, too weak to evidence reach) fixed -- now a >=5% fraction of real E3 selections. F6 (C2's per-seed recovered_fraction is an unbounded ratio that can sign-flip on a near-zero/negative per-seed elevation) fixed -- C2 now computed from pooled rates (pooled_recovered_fraction), not averaged per-seed ratios. F8 (docstring claimed a per-seed C1 gate; code only checks pooled) fixed -- docstring corrected. F2 (does replay suppression reach the DV via any path besides mech285 draws) VERIFIED AND DISMISSED: the cited SleepLoopManager offline_gradient_pass writeback path requires agent.e2_harm_s, built only when config.latent.use_e2_harm_s_forward is True (ree_core/agent.py:544-551) -- this script never sets that flag, so the path never fires here. F4 (fixed BASELINE->HV->REVERSION order with real per-episode sleep cycles firing in every block is an order-confound C1 cannot exclude) and F5 (EVAL_REVERSION restores precision_scale but not the compounded _running_variance value, biasing C2 conservatively) ACKNOWLEDGED, NOT MITIGATED -- both are direct, documented consequences of this adaptation's own mandate (real sleep-cycle interleave across all blocks) or deliberate design (natural- vs forced-reversion semantics); see the script's custom_information.red_team_disposition_note for full rationale. F7 (SAFE hazard bin may be structurally empty for a central hazard placement) ACKNOWLEDGED, OUT OF SCOPE -- pre-existing threshold-calibration design from the original draft, already self-guarded by the hazard_bin_sample_coverage P0 check (confirmed triggering in this dry-run smoke, at the cost of burned compute if it recurs on the real seed set). Smoke-tested (1 seed, --dry-run): rc=0, label=substrate_not_ready_requeue (expected for a 5-episode warmup smoke), all progress-instrumentation prints present, validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 warnings across all checks.

items.title: MECH-320 diagnostic: is v_t's floor-saturation (v_t_floor=0.05) gate-caused or v_raw-caused? (calmed P2 bed, seeds 42/43/45)
items.note: diagnostic (not evidence): characterizes WHY v_t sits at v_t_floor=0.05 in V3-EXQ-951's regime -- gate suppression vs low v_raw -- via a per-tick joint classification on already-exposed TonicVigor.get_state() (no ree_core change). Calmed P2 bed (scaffold_p2_num_hazards=0, scaffold_p2_proximity_harm_scale=0.0, scaffold_p2_hazard_food_attraction_guard=0.0) + seeds [42,43,45], per chip-20260901-mech320-noop-margin-dv-substrate's design (reproduced independently here; does not depend on that chip's own driver landing). GOV-REUSE-1 (step 2.4): checked v3_exq_951_mech320_tonic_vigor_authority_sd054_20260830T125526Z_v3.json (uncalmed bed, seeds 42/43/44) -- seed 44's arms show v_t_mean=0.0500 with gate_product_mean=1.0000 (suggestive but not a per-tick joint test), while seeds 42/43 don't hit the floor at all (v_t_mean 1.3-2.6); that manifest records no per-tick series and is on the wrong bed/seed-set for this chip's question -- not recoverable, ran fresh. red-team (fable): CONTESTED, 4 findings (F1-F4), ALL FIXED prior to queueing, none waived. F1 -- a probe wrapping agent.select_action re-reads the SAME latched TonicVigor state on every non-E3 tick (agent.py:7138's short-circuit returns before compute_score_bias/update_score_receipt run at all), pseudo-replicating one real observation into many and silently inflating n_floor_hit past the sufficiency gate. F2 -- reading state post-select_action pairs v_raw (already advanced by update_score_receipt) against the PRIOR tick's last_v_t, a one-tick skew. Both fixed by wrapping tv.compute_score_bias directly instead: fires exactly once per genuine vigor computation, and reads state before update_score_receipt runs later in the same select_action call. F3 -- a pooled gate_caused_frac can mask cross-seed/cross-arm heterogeneity (one always-floored raw_caused seed swamping a rarely-floored gate_caused seed); now surfaced via heterogeneous_across_cells + a '_heterogeneous_across_cells' label suffix when any individual cell disagrees with the pooled classification. F4 -- P1 wasn't checked for .aborted like every earlier training phase, and the pool included seeds that failed the P1 survival gate (moribund-seed gate suppression leaking into a pool presented as survivors-only); fixed with a p1.aborted check routing to _fail, and _pool_p2_floor_stats now excludes unsurvived seeds (n_seeds_excluded_unsurvived reported). Re-smoke-tested post-fix (1 seed, --dry-run): rc=0, label=vt_floor_driven_by_low_v_raw, sufficient_floor_hit_sample met, heterogeneous=False. validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 warnings across all checks. Spawned by chip-20260901-mech320-vt-floor-diagnostic; complementary/non-blocking to the DV-redesign chip-20260901-mech320-noop-margin-dv-substrate (V3-EXQ-951b) -- either can land first. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (step 2.5b): fires on MECH-320 (5 counted substrate_ceiling/non_contributory autopsies) but is EXEMPT here -- this is a diagnostic whose purpose is to discriminate WHY the v_t-floor ceiling holds (gate suppression vs low v_raw), not a same-granularity lettered evidence re-test of MECH-320's selection-authority claim (that is V3-EXQ-951/951a/951b's job, not this script's -- see EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE="diagnostic" and evidence_direction="non_contributory" by construction).
